telco_jobs_lease_check.name: telco_jobs_lease_check
telco_jobs_lease_check.value: ("app"."telco_jobs"."status" = 'running') = ("app"."telco_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null and "app"."telco_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

radian_events_accepted_check.name: radian_events_accepted_check
radian_events_accepted_check.value: "app"."radian_events"."status" <> 'accepted' or ("app"."radian_events"."cude" is not null and "app"."radian_events"."dian_registered_at" is not null)

dian_certificates_valid_check.name: dian_certificates_valid_check
dian_certificates_valid_check.value:
"app"."dian_certificates"."status" <> 'valid' or ("app"."dian_certificates"."serial_number" is not null and "app"."dian_certificates"."subject_nit" is not null
        and "app"."dian_certificates"."not_before" is not null and "app"."dian_certificates"."not_after" is not null
        and "app"."dian_certificates"."key_usage_ok" is true and "app"."dian_certificates"."chain_ok" is true)
